C0635.title: Consequences and Resolution of Duplicate Listings on Taobao
C0635.summary: Repeated violations by the same seller involving duplicate product listings can result in item removal, the delisting of all products in the store, and restrictions on publishing new items. This underscores the severe impact of duplicate listings on Taobao store operations.

references.title: How to resolve duplicate listings on Taobao? Are the consequences serious? - Zhihu
